intro.value: A small, central campsite on Byggðavegur in the fishing village of Sandgerði on the Reykjanes Peninsula (a UNESCO Global Geopark). The operator puts it 8 minutes' drive from Keflavík International Airport, about 24–25 minutes from the Blue Lagoon and 35 minutes from the Reykjavík area, which makes it a practical first or last night with a campervan. The service house has toilets, showers, outdoor sinks with hot and cold water, a washer and dryer; there is electricity for RVs, water refill, black and grey water disposal, free Wi-Fi and a playground. Small cabins for two can also be rented on site.

season.value: Open all year (Camping Card list 2026: 1 January – 31 December)
season.note: Parka.is shows 'Opið: 09. Jan – 31. Des' next to an 'Open all year' tag; the operator's own site states no season.

winter.value: Listed as open all year by tjalda.is, the 2026 Camping Card list (1 Jan – 31 Dec) and Parka.is's 'winter opening' tag, but Parka.is's opening dates start on 9 January, the operator's own site states no season, and Sandgerði is not on ferdalag.is's official camper winter service list. Ring ahead (+354 854 8424) before relying on it in deep winter, especially in early January.

applies_to.value: 2026 rates (tjalda.is and Parka.is price lists). The operator's own Campsite page still shows 2021 prices (adult 1,500 ISK, electricity 800 ISK), so expect the 2026 rates.

items.label: With Camping Card
items.value: 100 ISK (not valid during the town festival)

toilets.value: Yes – toilets in the service house; tjalda.is tags the site wheelchair accessible

laundry.value: Washing machine and dryer (500 ISK wash, 1,000 ISK wash & dry; dryer alone not possible). Parka.is also lists a drying area.

camping_card.value: Accepted – 100 ISK; not valid during the Suðurnesjabær town festival. Parka.is says the card covers 2 adults and 2 children per night; lodging tax and electricity are paid separately.

contact.value: +354 854 8424 · info@airportcamping.is (tjalda.is; Parka.is gives istay@istay.is) · airportcamping.is · Instagram @sandgerdicamping

electricity.value: Yes – electricity for RVs, 1,200 ISK per night

showers.value: Yes – showers in the service house; whether they are included or extra is not stated

kitchen.value: No guest kitchen listed by any source; there are outdoor sinks with hot and cold water and Parka.is lists a dishwashing facility

dump_station.value: Yes – 'black and grey water disposal' and water-tank refill on site (Parka.is facility tag 'Seyrulosun'); exact location on site not stated

practical.value: Tjalda.is says reservations are not possible except for large groups, so individual campers just turn up. Parka.is shows a pitch-booking page, but it currently says online booking for this campsite has not been activated.
Parka.is says a night runs from 13:00 to 12:00 the next day.
Grocery store, ATM, post box, museum, gym, swimming pool and sauna are within walking distance, according to the operator.
Children 14 and under stay free; adults are counted from age 15.
